content: We need number of carbonyl (C=O) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can use IR spectra to detect C=O stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). Probably easiest: get IR spectra and count C=O peaks (~1700 cm-1). Use ir_spectra tool. Then interpret. Let's call tool.
